summary: Faraday Future issued $25M senior convertible notes to institutional investors in a private placement under a Securities Purchase Agreement. The notes bear 8% interest, mature in one year, and are convertible into Class A common stock. Interest is payable in stock at conversion or maturity. The company committed to file a resale registration covering 200% of conversion shares within 45 days. No board recommendation or advisor named. Structure includes potential dilution from note conversion and registration obligations. Watch share price relative to conversion price for potential overhang; risk-arb angle hinges on stock volatility and dilute equity base.
